in_marathi.name: Jyotish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Astronomy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who knows or studies the stars and planets; a term for an astrologer in Indian culture. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'jyoti' meaning 'light' or 'knowledge'.

in_bengali.name: Jyotish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Astronomy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jyotish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who knows or studies the stars and planets; a term for an astrologer in Indian culture. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'jyoti' meaning 'light' or 'knowledge'.
